import numpy as np
def run(Fb,Gb,Hb,iters=300):
    # model: a*sqrtP + F(t).G(P) + H(t-basis) 
    Fm=np.c_[Fb]; Gm=np.c_[Gb]
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    g=rng.normal(size=Gm.shape[1]); 
    for it in range(iters):
        # given g, fit F coeffs and a and H jointly
        Pg=Gm@g
        X=np.c_[np.sqrt(P)]
        cols=[Fm*Pg[:,None], np.sqrt(P)[:,None]]+[h[:,None] for h in Hb]
        M=np.hstack(cols)
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(M,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        nF=Fm.shape[1]
        f=c[:nF]
        Ft=Fm@f
        # given F, fit g and others
        cols2=[Gm*Ft[:,None], np.sqrt(P)[:,None]]+[h[:,None] for h in Hb]
        M2=np.hstack(cols2)
        c2=np.linalg.lstsq(M2,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        g=c2[:Gm.shape[1]]
        pred=M2@c2
    return np.mean((pred-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), f, g, c2[Gm.shape[1]:]
